items.context: Dating and social startup; maintained two product lines (Sugarbee and Bound), responsible for app development, the NestJS backend, and paid AI features
jobDesc: Implemented subscription auto-renewal and failed-payment retries, increasing monthly revenue from NT$210K to NT$380K (+81%).
Developed four paid AI features — match suggestions, chat coaching, icebreakers, and bio generation — with a two-tier fallback that maintains service continuity during model failures.

Rewrote queries using virtual generated columns and composite indexes, reducing response time from 5 seconds to milliseconds with APIs averaging 180ms; first contentful paint improved from 10 seconds to 1.4 seconds.
Routed moderation by media type and cached generated results, reducing monthly cloud spend from US$1,200 to US$400 (−60%).
Built an AI support agent that retrieves FAQ and knowledge-base content through a Python RAG stack, escalating to a human agent when the confidence score falls below threshold.
Delivered the Flutter app, NestJS backend, and Docker deployment independently, integrating content moderation and real-person face verification.

items.context: Game and live-streaming platform; led 11 engineers and owned architecture and technical decisions across 12 product lines
jobDesc: Advanced a proof-of-concept mini-game to production and expanded it into a 12-title product line, leading 11 engineers through delivery.

Designed a microservice architecture to sustain high-concurrency traffic during draws and peak hours, using Kafka for cross-service event streams and Redis with Bull Queue for caching and asynchronous settlement.
Established a release checklist and standardized release process, reducing release defects by 70%.
Built out monitoring and logging with Sentry, Kibana, and Grafana, and standardized and documented troubleshooting procedures, improving problem isolation speed by 50%.
Introduced design review and code review, which were subsequently adopted as the shared development standard across product lines.

items.context: Game and lottery platform; responsible for backend development, system analysis, and restructuring inherited systems
jobDesc: Inherited an unmaintained system and refactored it into a layered module structure, enabling new game types to be built on the existing architecture without modifying core logic.
Served as lead backend engineer on the blockchain fair-random-number platform, combining multiple data sources into verifiable random numbers and implementing EOS smart contracts for on-chain proof.
Independently owned lottery game types, the crawler data pipeline, and the operations dashboard, covering schema design, API implementation, and production operations.
Performed index and query optimization on reporting and settlement bottlenecks to improve response time.

items.context: Software consultancy; delivered 7 client engagements spanning requirements analysis through production operations
jobDesc: Delivered lending systems, a video streaming platform, an equipment repair system, and e-commerce modules from zero to one, covering requirements analysis, system design, and production operations.
Built the video streaming platform on AWS, using Lambda with FFmpeg for transcoding and image blurring, and established an automated deployment pipeline replacing manual releases.
Selected technology stacks by project requirement, including C#, Node.js, React, and Salesforce (Apex, VisualForce).
Separated frontend and backend responsibilities and redesigned APIs to reduce module coupling, while establishing unit and functional testing processes.
Applied Clean Code and design patterns, unifying naming, layering, and responsibility boundaries.
Acted as first point of contact for new hires, maintaining environment setup and project documentation to shorten onboarding time.
